diffs.text: Press and hold the Power Button to summon Divine Light for up to 3s
Divine Light moves away from The Judgment and is controlled with camera controls (left/right only)
While in this state, Divine Light does not damage Survivors
If Divine Light passes through obstacles, it slows down
While controlling Divine Light, press the Attack Button to Cast it forward

When Cast, it enters a brief delay before it fully activates, damaging and applying Heresy to any Survivors hit. (Survivors inflicted with Heresy are known as Heretics) Dev note: Divine Light enters its lethal state when it becomes larger
When cast Divine Light is lethal and if misses a Survivor by 0.5m, reveal them with Killer Instinct for 2s
The longer Divine Light is controlled:
The shorter the Cast delay
The longer the Cast duration
Divine Light has a 6 second cooldown. Dev note: Divine Light's delay phase duration starts at 0.9s, after controlling Divine Light for 1s, the delay reaches its minimum of 0.3s

diffs.text: Press the Secondary Ability Button to Exile a Heretic in the Dying State, gaining Zealous. (If they have 2 Hook States, they are killed instead.)
Exiling a Survivor gives them a Hook State
When Exiling a Heretic:
The 2 closest Shrines of Judgment become Active
Zealous lasts for 60 seconds
Gain Killer Instinct on all Heretics for 3s. (only applies to Survivors with full Heresy)
While Zealous:
Increase Divine Light's size by 10%
Decrease Divine Light's cooldown by 20%
Maintain control of Divine Light for up to 0.3s

diffs.text: Exile acts like a Hook, but does not trigger Hook-related perks
Upon entering Exile, Survivors receive a Searcher's Pendant (Limited Item)
Exile is filled with dangerous Seeds of Punishment that reduce a Survivor's Sacrifice timer by 3s when hit
Exile is also filled with helpful Exiled Souls. Hold the Use Item button to point the Searcher's Pendant at Exiled Souls to collect them
For each Exiled Soul collected (up to 10), Survivors gain an additional 0.5s to default Unhook Protections (10% Haste, Endurance, and Elusive)
Exiled Souls no longer grant additional protections once all Generators are completed
Survivors who aren't in Exile can Pray at an active Shrine of Judgment (highlighted in red) to rescue Exiled Survivors

diffs.text: New Gameplay Showcase Section
Can be entered through Survivors and Killers lobbies
Killer Power's icon is also a point of entry for the section
Section includes detailed description of all Killers' Powers, separated by killer and Key Aspect
Each Key Aspect is accompanied by an example video
Section includes the list of Killers for players to be able to preview their power
Only accessible outside matches
Power Tooltip updated
Old Power Tooltip used to describe a Killer Power entirely is updated
Content has been removed, replaced by the same Action-based description used on the F1 section of Match Details
Updated Matchmaking Button
Updated visuals, and reduced its intensity, following PTB's feedback
Surfaces both estimated waiting time and current time on queue
Bonuses and other complementary information is displayed through new tooltip
Hook Timer Division
The hook timer has been split into two bars, to better clarify the second hook state and death triggers
Updated for scenarios when a Survivor is on a hook, in a Cage of Corruption (Game Mode: 2V8) or Cage of Torment (The Executioner), and in Exile (The Judgment)
MMR Update
The way MMR is calculated has now changed, it will no longer count only Kills and Escapes. Similar to Emblems it will now consider more actions within a trial

items: Fixed an issue where subtitles might have disappeared before voice over finished.
Fixed an issue where Aurora's hooked voice lines would not play.
Fixed an issue where Aurora's failed skill check voice lines would not play.
Fixed an issue where The Slasher's Mini Mori wall-impale on Survivor had the Spike misaligned.
Fixed an issue where William Birkin's skins were missing a few idle animations.
Fixed an issue where The Clown's knife cleaning animation after a successful basic attack was not properly aligned with his hand.
Fixed an issue where the Huntress's Axe was misaligned when she was about to throw her hatchet.
Fixed an issue where The Artist's weapon briefly appears in the lobby when wearing the 'Miss Fuchi' outfit.
Fixed an issue where Yui Kimura's upper left chest caved inward when wearing the 'Mikasa's Dark Uniform' outfit during the idle lobby animation.
Fixed an issue where Ash J. Williams's ankles caved inward when wearing the 'Water Trash' outfit.
Fixed an issue where Legion's 'Hunk' legendary outfit's hand would clip into the pouch in the main menu.
Fixed an issue where The Unknown's Greenville Pep and Greenville Cheer cosmetics' teeth appeared to be stuck together, resulting in them stretching during the killer's Mori.
Fixed an issue where the VFX for the Pride's flashlight was missing.
Fixed an issue where The Blight's Lethal Rush Attack was unable to hit Survivors when the Survivor was inside the Killer's hitbox.
Fixed an issue where The Blight's side movements were disabled after the second Rush.
Fixed an issue where The Executioner's Punishment of the Damned failed to travel uphill.
Fixed an issue where The Skull Merchant's prompt to Deploy a Drone appeared within the Anti-Camp radius when on a different height.
Fixed an issue where Killers were unaffected by the movement penalty when a Survivor was wiggling.
Fixed an issue where Survivors were able to escape while The Twins' Victor had them bound.
Fixed an issue where idle Generators regressed when affected by Aurora Stardotter's Boon: Steadfast.
Fixed an issue where addon status effects from The Pig's add-ons were not applied to Survivors when the Video Tape add-on was also used.
Fixed an issue where the camera jittered a lot while The Wraith was invisible.
Fixed an issue where The Demogorgon could become invisible while entering a portal with lag.
Fixed an issue where The Nurse could remain stuck on top of a fence after a Blink on Autohaven Wreckers.
Fixed issues causing Survivor bots to not dodge special attacks toward the intended direction.
Survivor Bots now have a chance to misdodge Special attacks based on how fast they reacted to the attack.
Fixed issues causing Survivor bots to not heal other Survivors.
Survivor Bots are now more brave against Killers that are not moving away from a location.
Fixed an issue causing Survivor Bots to give up their goal too easily when entering the Terror Radius.
Survivor Bots no longer try to remove an inactive Reverse Bear Trap after all generators have been completed.
Fixed an issue causing Survivor Bots to prevent heals while in the Dying state.
Fixed an issue in Yamaoka's Family Residence where the Nurse could blink on top railings
Fixed an issue in Nostromos where navigation is hindered by collisions
Fixed an issue in Eyrie of Crows where the Nurse can blink inside of the stairs
Fixed an issue in Treatment Theater where the Nightmare gets stuck in the main room
Fixed an issue in Gideon Meat Plant where the Nurse could blink out of the environment
Fixed an issue in Toba Landing where the Nurse can blink under the main structure
Fixed an issue in Freddy Fazzbear's Pizza the Nurse could not blink through the wall
Fixed an issue in Ironworks of Misery where the Nurse can blink through the stairs
Fixed an issue in Autohaven Wreckers where the Nurse get stuck under the hill of the realm
Fixed an issue in the Exile tile where the players would get stuck on rocks on the ground
Fixed an issue in Toba Landing where a rock clips through the inside of the locker
Fixed an issue in Balckwater Swamp Realm where the Nurse can get stuck under floor board
Fixed an issue in Grim Pantry where the Nurse can get stuck inside a rock
Fixed an issue in Trickster's Delusion where lockers are doubled in the alley near the night club
Fixed an issue in Mother's Dwelling where the dark lord gets stuck against a meat hook in the smoke house when in bat form
Fixed an issue where The Skull Merchant was unable to deploy a Drone on the stairs and on the 2nd floor of the Main Building on Dvarka Deepwood
Fixed an issue on the Autohaven Wreckers - Blood Lodge's map where the Nurse can Blink on top of the fence and be stuck between the fence and chimney.
Fixed an issue where Plot Twist deactivated the Corrupt Intervention Perk early.
Fixed an issue where Plot Twist could trigger Eruption
Fixed an issue where Hex: Under Your Thumb's external icon was displayed to Survivors without the Haste Status Effect.
Fixed an issue where Boon: Steadfast's repair speed effect did not apply upon blessing the Totem while a Survivor was repairing a Generator.
Fixed an issue where Boon: Steadfast's effect stacked when a Generator was in range of two Boon Totems.
The DBD game logo has been updated to the latest version across the game
The Players Tab in Match Details now shows the Killer's Portrait instead of their Power Icon
It is a known issue that a handful of Legendary cosmetics to not have a Killer Portrait icon. This will be fixed in an upcoming release.
Fixed an issue where the game would freeze for a bit when hovering over the quest button.
Fixed an issue where the faces on The Judgment's legs were missing from the Customization icons
Fixed an issue where an incorrect image was displayed on the interrupt and grab 1 survivor(s) quest
